headline: Transcript-level structure is resolved from long-read, short-read and single-cell RNA-seq
label: Isoform Resolved Transcriptome Tooling
summary: Long-read and single-cell RNA-seq now support transcript annotation and splicing or polyadenylation analysis without relying on prior transcript models.
synthesis: The dominant thread is resolving transcript-level structure and carrying it into downstream interpretation. splicelogic converts differences between transcript sets into discrete events such as exon skipping and intron retention. SQANTI-evidence annotates unannotated genomes from long-read RNA-seq alone, combining SQANTI3-curated isoforms with AUGUSTUS predictions. MOCHI applies a reference-independent k-mer framework to strand-specific short-read data to curate candidate independent intronic transcripts. scPolyA and scSpAS extend this to alternative polyadenylation and to single-cell and spatial contexts, with scSpAS integrating ATS, splicing, APA and full-length isoforms across 123 datasets. DirectClean addresses artifacts and chimeras in ONT direct-cDNA reads. Terminus est repurposes public bacterial RNA-seq to map 3' termini. The newer element is reuse of existing read data to recover structural features.
